description: No key needed. The fixed exam locations (name, address, city, latitude, longitude) of a catalogue group with location_mode configured_locations, such as the CBR theory exam centres. Pick the one in the city the customer named (ask when there are several); search availability with its latitude and longitude and pass its name as exam_location to tolk2go_interpreting_create_booking. Do not ask the customer for the address.

situation_id.description: ID or slug from tolk2go_interpreting_list_situations, e.g. cbr

name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_catalog_locations
title: List exam locations
